'''June 2001 Reflections II Booster Draft (19 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft on 19 June 2001. [[Ryan McLain]] won it. It is known from Ryan McLain's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2490">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-20-what-the-stores-closing-wtfd2490/ what-the-stores-closing-wtf], DeckTech (Ryan "_Rx_" McLain, 20 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-20-what-the-stores-closing-wtfd2490/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 June 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Ryan McLain]]
